title: TSS Context Schema
description: A bounded stewardship domain with explicit scope. Defined by TSS v1.2.0 §5.1 and §6. v1.2: relaxed `stewards` to accept a single steward reference or an array; added is_template, template_id, needs_framework, stewardship_phase; added QSM_META to the type enum. v1.3: added learning_framework (QSM §4.2.2); updated needs_framework notes to include 'sdt'.

type.description: Declared context type. QSM_META (added v1.2.0) is a singleton, non-steward-owned governance context — see QSM §6.1, QSM-META-01. Additional types MAY be added in future versions.

stewards.description: One or more responsible steward identifiers. MAY be a single string reference or an array (added v1.2.0). A QSM_META context is exempt from this requirement (QSM-META-01) and SHOULD omit this field or set it to an empty array.

scope.description: Explicit scope boundary for the context.

is_template.description: Added v1.2.0. True if this Context is a non-steward-owned template to be duplicated into instances. See QSM §6.2, QSM-TPL-01.

template_id.description: Added v1.2.0. References the template Context (is_template: true, same type) this instance was duplicated from, if any. See QSM §6.2, QSM-TPL-02.

needs_framework.description: Added v1.2.0. The default needs framework for entities in this Context, e.g. 'maslow', 'well', 'erg', 'pink', 'sdt'. See QSM §4.2.1. Informative; not required for conformance.

learning_framework.description: Added v1.2.0 (QSM-LF-01). The learning framework used by this Context's Adaptation layer, e.g. 'kolb', 'pdca', 'after-action-review', 'double-loop'. See QSM §4.2.2. Informative; not required for conformance.

stewardship_phase.description: Added v1.2.0. The Context's current position in the LOCUS → ATLAS → TENURE lifecycle. See TSS §6.2. RECOMMENDED, not required below T3. Not applicable to QSM_META contexts (TSS-PHASE-04).
